## The 10 Hardest Upgrades / Fixes This Repo Needs

1. ~~**Monolithic +page.svelte (1,444 lines) — Component Extraction** — The script section held 46 `$state` variables, 15 async handlers, 6 `$derived` values, and zero unit-test surface. All business logic lived in one 690-line blob with no seam boundary. Fixed in this PR.~~

2. **Result\<\> Type Inconsistency Across Seams** — New self-contained seams use `Result<T, CustomError>` while several legacy flat-layout seams use the default `SeamError`. No automated check enforces which error type a seam uses. Callers must know the error shape per-seam; refactoring error handling is a 20-file, high-risk operation.

3. **PromptCompilerSeam & GalleryStoreSeam Fixtures Remain Stubbed** — Both mocks have TODO comments requiring fixture scenarios per SDD conventions. Both are blocked pending XAI_API_KEY probes. Tests pass only against hardcoded defaults, not real output shapes.

4. **ProviderAdapterSeam Retry Logic Under-Tested** — `http-resilience.ts` retry covers the main paths, but 500/502/504 status codes, the already-aborted upstream signal edge case, and body-drain behavior on retry are not individually verified.

5. **Browser Storage Seams Stale (4+ months)** — SessionSeam, CreationStoreSeam, AuthContextSeam last probed 2026-02-05. No coverage for localStorage quota-exceeded, private-browsing disabled-storage, or silent fallback UI when storage is unavailable.

6. **ImageGenerationSeam Dual-Layout Dead Code** — The legacy flat-layout adapter (`src/lib/adapters/image-generation.adapter.ts`) and its test/fixture/mock files still exist alongside the new self-contained seam that is already wired as primary. Dead code inflates the test surface and confuses future contributors.

7. **WigTryOnSeam Probe Blocked** — The wig try-on feature has never been probed end-to-end (`TBD (blocked)` since 2026-05-11). Requires `GEMINI_API_KEY`. No Playwright e2e test covers the selfie → Gemini → portrait → coloring-page pipeline.

8. **MeechieStudioTextSeam Prompt Injection Risk** — The evidence field (free-text from the user) feeds directly into the system prompt via the pipeline with no documented prompt-injection mitigation. `findDisallowedKeywords` has no unit tests for XSS or injection patterns. Provider schema enforcement is the only barrier.

9. **CacheSeam PWA Integration Manual-Only** — CacheSeam was probed manually via DevTools (2026-05-15). No Playwright test covers PWA install → offline → stale-cache eviction → fresh-asset load. The `DECISIONS.md` workaround for Vite's SW bundler is documented but untested.

10. **Evidence Freshness & Cipher Gate Enforcement Gaps** — `npm run verify` generates fresh evidence but there is no tool that checks whether existing evidence artifacts are stale relative to HEAD file modifications. Cipher Gate entries can reference outdated evidence indefinitely without triggering CI failure.

---

## What This PR Does (Item 1)

**Before:** `src/routes/+page.svelte` — 1,444 lines with a 690-line `<script>` block containing all studio business logic.

**After:**
- `src/lib/core/studio-state.svelte.ts` — 646-line Svelte 5 runes class (`StudioState`) owning all state and logic
- `src/routes/+page.svelte` — 26-line script (lifecycle only) + unchanged template + unchanged CSS

### Approach

Used Svelte 5's officially supported `.svelte.ts` runes class pattern:

```typescript
export class StudioState {
  // 46 reactive fields
  textOutput = $state<MeechieStudioTextOutput | null>(null);

  // 6 derived fields (track reactive reads through `this`)
  canGenerateText = $derived(canRunStudioAction('generate_text', {
    remainingBudget: this.revisionBudget,
    isRunning: this.isTextWorking
  }));

  // Arrow-function handlers preserve stable `this` as component callbacks
  runTextAction = async (actionId: StudioTextActionId) => { ... };

  // Lifecycle extracted as init() / destroy()
  async init() { ... }   // called from onMount
  destroy() { ... }      // called from onDestroy
}
```

Module-level constants (`STUDIO_WEEKLY_MODES`, `STUDIO_MONTHLY_MODE_ID`) are exported for the template's static bindings. The `bind:` directives work unchanged because Svelte 5's `$state` proxy supports property assignment on class instances.

### Verification

- `svelte-check`: **0 errors, 0 warnings**
- `npm test`: **419/419 tests pass** (1 skipped — integration, requires env)

## Test plan

- [ ] `npm run check` — passes (0 errors)
- [ ] `npm test` — 419/419 pass
- [ ] Start dev server, load the studio page, confirm all panels render
- [ ] Generate Meechie verdict → confirm text flows to preview
- [ ] Change a setting → confirm spec updates and draft saves
- [ ] Wig select + selfie upload → confirm state updates in WigTryOnStudio

## Reviewer's Guide Extracts the 690-line Meechie Studio page script into a dedicated Svelte 5 runes-based StudioState class, leaving +page.svelte as a thin lifecycle wrapper that wires the new state object into existing child components without changing UI behavior. #### Sequence diagram for StudioState.runTextAction interaction ```mermaid sequenceDiagram actor User participant StudioHero participant StudioState participant HttpClient as postJson participant StudioPreviewPanel User->>StudioHero: click run text action StudioHero->>StudioState: runTextAction(actionId) StudioState->>StudioState: validate evidence alt evidence invalid StudioState-->>StudioHero: set textError else evidence ok StudioState->>HttpClient: postJson(/api/meechie-studio-text, payload) HttpClient-->>StudioState: response StudioState->>StudioState: MeechieStudioTextResultSchema.safeParse alt parse and result ok StudioState->>StudioState: update textOutput StudioState->>StudioState: update canGenerateText and budget StudioState-->>StudioPreviewPanel: reactive props update else error StudioState->>StudioState: set textError end end ``` ### File-Level Changes | Change | Details | Files | | ------ | ------- | ----- | | Encapsulated all Meechie Studio page business logic and state in a Svelte 5 runes class and exposed stable, reactive API for the template. |
  • Introduced StudioState class in a .svelte.ts module that owns all former page-level $state fields, derived values, async handlers, and lifecycle logic.
  • Recreated all previous reactive fields as $state properties on the class, including studio text state, page spec, validation, generation, vault, and wig try-on state.

  • Updated all component props and bind: directives to read/write through the studio instance (e.g., studio.evidence, studio.activeMode, studio.runTextAction).

## Code Review

This pull request refactors the Meechie Studio page by extracting its complex state and logic from `+page.svelte` into a dedicated, self-contained Svelte 5 state class, `StudioState`, leaving the page component as a thin lifecycle wrapper. The review feedback focuses on optimizing Svelte 5 reactivity by utilizing `$state.snapshot` to pass clean, non-reactive objects to external adapters, APIs, and validation methods. Additionally, the feedback suggests improving error handling in `saveToVault`, removing redundant input handling in `handleDedicationInput` due to Svelte's two-way binding, and refactoring `runTextAction` to validate inputs before triggering the loading state.
